clock_law.rule: available_at must be the earliest recoverable market-availability clock for the material claim, not a later article, video-asset, clip-upload, or recap timestamp
clock_law.reuters_connect_video_rule: a Reuters Connect licensable-video timestamp is evidence of that asset's availability only; it is not accepted as first market dissemination when earlier text/feed publication exists or remains unresolved
clock_law.conflicting_syndication_rule: when republisher clocks disagree and no original wire tick is pinned, the event is clock_unresolved and excluded from primary return measurement
clock_law.repeated_confirmation_rule: a later confirmation of an already-public deal is not a new independent event unless it adds material new information; otherwise it is context or a separate confirmation stratum
clock_law.outcome_rule: this audit was performed before fetching outcomes for the newly admitted clock-clean candidates below
